attack.summary: Engage a hostile character for pulse combat.
details: Engagement persists while you reposition. Basic auto attacks pulse slowly and only connect up close.

body.summary: Display your body resources and recovery readiness.
details: Shows nutrition, hydration, fatigue, recovery state, and short-rest chakra recovery.

bfind.summary: Search authored rooms, templates, and spawns.
details: Admin builder command. Searches room VNUMs, titles, descriptions, template keys, names, keywords, and spawn references.
Use bug <message> to append a timestamped report to bugs.md for later triage.

bundo.summary: Undo the most recent builder zone mutation.
details: Admin builder command. Restores the previous zone JSON snapshot recorded before the latest successful builder edit.

buildzone.summary: Create, anchor, and enter a usable authored zone.
details: Admin builder command. Creates an anchored zone file, assigns its VNUM range, places the starting room at the given grid coordinate, and moves you into it.
Use zonelist afterward to confirm placement, then use redit, dig, createnpc, iedit, spawnnpc, and spawnitem to author the first playable slice.

color.summary: Toggle ANSI terminal colors for this connection.
details: Use color off if your client does not render ANSI colors cleanly.

combat.summary: Display your active combat engagement and stance.
details: Combat persists while you reposition. Basic auto attacks only connect up close; skills and jutsus can later queue range, accuracy, damage, and status modifiers.

commands.summary: List every command with a brief description.
details: This catalog includes admin-only commands so the full command surface remains discoverable.
Use this before combat to review a visible NPC's health and authored combat values.

Builder command. Reports broken exits, missing spawn templates, invalid VNUMs, duplicate VNUMs, overlapping coordinates, out-of-bounds rooms, unsupported item metadata, and unsupported NPC behavior or AI fields.

zpublish.summary: Validate and publish authored zone changes.
details: Admin builder command. Runs zone validation, marks the zone published, reloads overlays, and records a builder audit entry.
Soft restarts remain intentionally disabled during private alpha.
Admin builder command. Copies an existing item template under a new builder key for fast variations.
Admin builder command. Copies an existing NPC template under a new builder key for fast variations.

cloneroom.summary: Clone an authored room inside its zone.
details: Admin builder command. Copies a room into a free VNUM in the same zone with exits cleared.

createnpc.summary: Create a basic static authored NPC template.
details: Builder command. Creates an NPC template in the current authored zone; the key must be unique and builder-safe.

Follow with medit to set description, dialogue, behavior, movement, aggression, loot, emote, health, damage, accuracy, evasion, respawn timing, and leash radius, then spawnnpc to seed the NPC in a room.
Admin builder command. Creates a JSON zone file with an available VNUM range. Use buildzone for the faster one-step anchored workflow.
Admin builder command. Creates a new authored room in the requested cardinal direction from the current overlay room.
The command writes a reciprocal exit, assigns the next VNUM in the zone range, and refuses to overwrite an occupied overlay coordinate.

description.summary: View or update your character description.
details: Use description with no text to view your current description, or description <text> to replace it.
Admin builder command. Removes a finite item spawn from the current authored zone JSON.
Admin builder command. Removes an NPC spawn from the current authored zone JSON.

drink.summary: Drink a carried beverage to restore hydration.
details: Consumables are finite carried items and are removed after use.

drop.summary: Drop a carried item at your location.
details: Dropped items persist at your current grid coordinate.

eat.summary: Eat a carried food item to restore nutrition.
details: Consumables are finite carried items and are removed after use.

emote.summary: Perform an action at your location.
details: Characters in your room will see the authored action text.

examine.summary: Inspect a visible or carried item.
details: Item targets accept names, keywords, prefixes, and ordinals such as 2.kunai.

feint.summary: Queue Feint for the next combat pulse.
details: Technique command. Costs 3 stamina and gives the next eligible combat pulse a large accuracy bonus plus a small damage bonus.

finger.summary: Inspect detailed player account, stats, skills, and jutsus.
details: Admin command. Shows player access, online state, created and last-login timestamps, identity, resources, attributes, body state, location, skill progress, and jutsu progress without exposing password data.

get.summary: Pick up an item at your location.
details: Item targets accept names, keywords, prefixes, and ordinals such as 2.kunai.

goto.summary: Travel to an authored room, grid location, or online player.
details: Admin command. Coordinates remain canonical even when teleporting to an overlay VNUM.

guard.summary: Queue Guard for the next combat pulse.
details: Technique command. Costs 2 stamina, skips your next outgoing pulse attack, improves evasion, and reduces incoming damage for that pulse.

help.summary: List commands or explain one command.
details: Help prose is loaded from helpfiles/commands.json and can be refreshed without restarting the server.

hedit.summary: Edit command help prose and publish state.
details: Admin builder command. Supports summary, detail, category, publish, and unpublish edits for command help.

ilist.summary: List authored item templates in a zone.
details: Admin builder command. Shows item keys, names, and types for the current or named zone.
Equipped slots are displayed alongside carried items.

iedit.summary: Create or edit an authored item template.
details: Builder command. Use iedit create <item_key> <name> to create a template, then iedit <item_key> <field> <value> to revise it.

Supported fields include name, description, keywords, type, slot, flags, use text, damage, throw damage, nutrition, hydration, value, weight, stack, and capacity. Use istat to inspect the result before spawning it.
Admin builder command. Displays the current editable fields for one globally keyed item template.

jutsu.summary: List available jutsus, inspect one, or show the full catalog.
details: Use jutsu all to include catalog placeholders that are not implemented yet.

loc.summary: Display your grid coordinates and area.
details: Coordinates are the canonical source of truth; overlay VNUMs are optional authored metadata.

look.summary: Display your location or inspect an item.
details: Use look with no arguments for the room and nearby map, or look at <item> to inspect an item.
Alias: ne.
Alias: nw.
Builder command. Use medit <npc_key> <field> <value> after createnpc to revise authored NPC data.

Supported fields include name, description, dialogue, behavior, movement, aggression, loot, emote, health, damage, accuracy, evasion, respawn, and leash. Use mstat before spawning to verify the template.

mlist.summary: List authored NPC templates in a zone.
details: Admin builder command. Shows NPC keys, names, and behavior for the current or named zone.
Admin builder command. Displays the current editable fields for one globally keyed NPC template.

ooc.summary: Speak on the global out-of-character channel.
details: Use this for player discussion that is not spoken by your character.

placezone.summary: Anchor a zone file on the world grid.
details: Admin builder command. Reloads overlay coordinates after persisting the new anchor.
Admin command. Lists every saved player with online status, access flags, identity summary, location, and last-login timestamp. Use finger for full inspection and pedit or pset for edits.

prac.summary: List skills or inspect usage-based proficiency.
details: Ordinary skill proficiency increases through valid gameplay use. Active practice reports visible tier progress without raw percentages.

pedit.summary: Edit access and validated persistent player fields.
details: Admin command. Use pedit <username> builder on or pedit <username> builder off to grant or remove builder access without granting full admin power. It also accepts the same validated player fields as pset.

pset.summary: Set a validated persistent player field.
details: Admin command. Supports admin and builder access, specialty, dojo, clan, release, resources, attributes, nutrition, hydration, and fatigue. Passwords, usernames, and locations require separate workflows.
Admin command. Compatibility alias for finger; displays detailed player state without exposing password data.

reloadcontent.summary: Reload authored JSON content into live state.
details: Admin builder command. Imports template edits and missing one-time spawns without restarting.

recover.summary: Queue Recover for the next combat pulse.
details: Technique command. Costs no stamina, skips your next outgoing pulse attack, and restores stamina on that pulse up to your maximum stamina.

rest.summary: Recover stamina and chakra through a short rest.
details: Rest consumes nutrition and hydration. Depleted nutrition or hydration blocks recovery.
Admin builder command. Supports title, description, flags, explicit exits, reciprocal links, and unlinking for the current authored room.
Use redit flag <flag> <on|off>, redit exit <direction> <vnum|none>, redit link <direction> <vnum> [oneway], or redit unlink <direction> [oneway].
Admin builder command. Refuses deletion while the room has exits, incoming links, or authored spawns.

roomdesc.summary: Replace the current authored room description.
details: Admin builder command. Updates the current overlay room description in authored JSON. Use redit desc <text> when working inside the broader editing suite.
Admin builder command. Displays room title, description, offsets, flags, and exits.

rlist.summary: List authored rooms in a zone.
details: Admin builder command. Shows VNUMs, room titles, and coordinate offsets for the current or named zone.

say.summary: Speak to characters at your location.

details: Shows core resources, attributes, specialty, clan, release, dojo alignment, and location.
Admin command.
Admin command.
Admin command.

shout.summary: Speak to characters within one grid cell.
details: Shouts reach your room and adjacent grid coordinates.
Admin command. Connected players are disconnected by the normal server shutdown.

skill.summary: List available skills, inspect one, or show the full catalog.
details: Use skill all to include catalog placeholders that are not implemented yet.
Alias: se.
Alias: sw.

stance.summary: List or change your combat stance.
details: Use stance with no argument to list the neutral S1-S5 placeholder profiles. S1 favors accuracy, S2 damage, S3 balance, S4 evasion, and S5 damage reduction.

strike.summary: Queue Strike for the next combat pulse.
details: Technique command. Costs 2 stamina and adds damage to your next eligible combat pulse attack.

spawnnpc.summary: Persist a spawn for an authored NPC template.
details: Admin builder command. Creates a persistent authored NPC seed in the current overlay room. Use mstat first to confirm the template and reloadcontent if live state needs to be refreshed.

spawnitem.summary: Persist a finite authored item seed.
details: Admin builder command. Places one finite authored item seed in the current overlay room. Use istat first to confirm keywords, type, and use fields.

spawnlist.summary: List authored item and NPC spawns.
details: Admin builder command. Shows item and NPC spawn keys, template references, and target VNUMs.

suggest.summary: Record a player suggestion for builders and maintainers.
details: Use suggest <message> to append a timestamped entry to suggestions.md.
Shows a wider grid view than look, including nearby player and NPC map markers.

talk.summary: Talk to a character at your location.
details: Targets a visible authored NPC in your room.

technique.summary: List or queue a stamina-based fighting technique.
details: Use technique with no argument to list available pulse techniques, or technique <name> to queue one for your next eligible combat pulse. Queueing a new technique replaces the previous queued technique.

throw.summary: Throw a carried ranged item at a nearby hostile character.
details: Valid throws increase Throw proficiency and land the item at the target location, even on a miss.

train.summary: List jutsus or inspect usage-based proficiency.
details: Jutsu proficiency increases through valid gameplay use. Active training reports visible tier progress without raw percentages.
Substitution Technique currently spends 3 chakra, lasts 30 seconds, and has a 60 second cooldown.

whisper.summary: Send a private message to an online character.

details: The item must define an authored equipment slot.
Admin builder command. With no VNUM, inspects the current location.

zonelist.summary: List authored zones and placement status.
details: Admin builder command. Shows filenames, display names, VNUM ranges, anchors, and room counts.
Admin builder command. Refuses deletion while external exits or authored spawns still reference the zone.
Admin builder command. Shows range, anchor, room count, template counts, and spawn counts for one zone.
